akhfash:2-2.t: He said: ﴿رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ﴾: He put (ما) with "رُبَّ" so that the verb could be spoken after it. If you wish, you may make (ما) have the status of "شَيْءٍ" (a thing), as though you said "and many a thing they wish", i.e. "many a wish that those who disbelieved wish".

akhfash:18-18.t: He said: ﴿إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ﴾: a disjoined exception, as he said "ما أَشْتَكِي إِلاَّ خَيْراً" (I complain of nothing but good), meaning "I mention [only] good".

akhfash:22-22.t: [He said:] ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ﴾: He made it [plural of] "لاقِح" (impregnated), as though the winds were impregnated, because there is good in them, so they have been impregnated with good. Some said "the winds impregnate the clouds"; this may also indicate that meaning, because when they raise them and there is good in them, that reaches them [the clouds].

akhfash:39-39.t: He said: ﴿رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِي﴾; he says: "by Your leading me astray"; ﴿لأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ﴾ is by way of an oath, as you say "بِاللهِ لأَفْعَلَنَّ" (By Allah, I shall surely do it).

akhfash:41-41.t: He said: ﴿هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾; he says: "upon Me is guidance to it", like the Arabs' saying "عَلَيَّ الطريقُ الليلة" (the road is upon me tonight), i.e. guiding along it is my duty.

akhfash:44-44.t: He said: ﴿لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ﴾, because it is from "جَزَّأْتُهُ" (I divided it into parts); and (مِنْهُمْ) means "of the people".

akhfash:53-53.t: He said: ﴿قَالُواْ لاَ تَوْجَلْ﴾, because it is from "وَجِلَ" "يَوْجَلُ". Whatever is of the pattern "فَعِل" with imperfect "يَفْعَلُ" keeps the wāw visible and does not lose it as it is lost in "يَزِنُ", because "وَزَنَ" is "فَعَلَ". As for Banū Tamīm, they say (تِيْجَلُ), because for "فَعِلَ" they say "تِفْعَل": they give kasra to the tāʾ of "تَفْعَل", the alif of "أفْعَلُ" and the nūn of "نَفْعَلُ"; [Translator's note: the source prints «تْفَعلُ» for the nūn-prefixed form.] but they do not give kasra to the yāʾ, because kasra is of the nature of yāʾ, so they found the combination heavy. Yet they did give kasra to the yāʾ in the category of "وَجِلَ", because the wāw had turned into yāʾ with the tāʾ, the nūn and the alif. Had they given it fatḥa, they would have rejected the wāw, and had they given the yāʾ fatḥa the wāw would have come back; so they gave the yāʾ kasra and said "يِيجَلُ", so that what follows it would be yāʾ, [since]* yāʾ with yāʾ is lighter than wāw with yāʾ, because one flees from wāw to yāʾ and does not flee from yāʾ to wāw. Some said (يَيْجَلُ), changing it into yāʾ and leaving the preceding letter with fatḥa, disliking the combination of kasra and two yāʾs.

akhfash:56-56.t: He said: ﴿وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ﴾, because it is from "قَنَطَ" "يَقْنِطُ". Some read (يَقْنُطُ), like "يَقْتُل", and "يقنَطَ" like "عَلِمَ" "يَعْلَمُ". [Translator's note: the text quoted shows «يَقْنَطُ», while the comment derives it as «يَقْنِطُ»; translated as written.]

akhfash:58-59.t: He said: ﴿إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ إِلاَّ آلَ لُوطٍ﴾: an exception from "the criminals", i.e. they are not included in the crime.

akhfash:66-66.t: He said: ﴿وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ ٱلأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلآءِ﴾, because His words ﴿أَنَّ دَابِرَ﴾ are a badal (substitute) for (الامر).

akhfash:72-72.t: He said: ﴿لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي﴾. By (لَعَمْرُكَ) — and Allah knows best — and "وَعَيْشِكَ" (by your life) one means only "life" (al-ʿumr). "العُمْرُ" and "العَمْرُ" are two dialect forms.

akhfash:91-91.t: He said: ﴿عِضِين﴾; it is from "الأَعْضاء" (limbs), and its singular is "العِضَةُ", like "العِزِينَ" whose singular is "العِزَةُ".

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الر﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ these verses ﴿آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Quran; the iḍāfa (genitive construct) is in the sense of "min" (of) ﴿وَقُرْآنٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ which makes the truth plain, distinct from falsehood; it is a conjoining (ʿaṭf) with the addition of a description.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿رُبَّمَا﴾ with doubling (tashdīd) and without it [رُبَمَا] ﴿يَوَدُّ﴾ wish ﴿الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ on the Day of Resurrection, when they see their own state and the state of the Muslims ﴿لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ﴾. And "rubba" here is for multiplicity (taktīr), for that wish will be frequent among them; and it is said: for paucity (taqlīl), for the terrors will bewilder them so that they do not come to their senses enough to wish that, except at a few moments.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿ذَرْهُمْ﴾ leave the disbelievers, O Muhammad ﴿يَأْكُلُوا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ with their worldly life ﴿وَيُلْهِهِمْ﴾ and let it occupy them ﴿الْأَمَلُ﴾ [hope] of long life and other things, away from faith ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the outcome of their affair. This was before the command to fight.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾ its people are meant ﴿إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ﴾ a term ﴿مَعْلُومٌ﴾ fixed for its destruction.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾ they are not delayed beyond it.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca, to the Prophet ﷺ ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ﴾ the Quran, as he claims ﴿إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ﴾

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿لَوْمَا﴾ why not ﴿تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ in your saying that you are a prophet and that this Quran is from Allah. Allah the Exalted said:

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿مَا تَنَزَّلُ﴾ in it one of the two tāʾs has been dropped ﴿الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with the punishment ﴿وَمَا كَانُوا إِذًا﴾ i.e. when the angels descend with the punishment ﴿مُنْظَرِينَ﴾ granted respite [مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ]

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ﴾ an emphasis (tawkīd) of the noun of inna, or a separating pronoun (faṣl) ﴿نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ﴾ the Quran ﴿وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ﴾ from alteration, distortion, addition and diminution.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ messengers ﴿فِي شِيَعِ﴾ the sects ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿وَمَا﴾ there used to ﴿يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾ just as your people mock you; and this is a consolation for him.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ﴾ i.e. just as We placed denial in the hearts of those, We place it ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ﴾ in the Prophet ﷺ ﴿وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ i.e. Allah's way with them, of punishing them for their denial of their prophets; and these are like them.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوا فِيهِ﴾ in the gate ﴿يَعْرُجُونَ﴾ ascending

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿لَقَالُوا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ﴾ have been blocked ﴿أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَسْحُورُونَ﴾ that is made to appear to us.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا﴾ twelve: Aries (al-Ḥamal), Taurus (al-Thawr), Gemini (al-Jawzāʾ), Cancer (al-Saraṭān), Leo (al-Asad), Virgo (al-Sunbula), Libra (al-Mīzān), Scorpio (al-ʿAqrab), Sagittarius (al-Qaws), Capricorn (al-Jady), Aquarius (al-Dalw) and Pisces (al-Ḥūt). They are the mansions of the seven moving planets: Mars, to which belong Aries and Scorpio; Venus, to which belong Taurus and Libra; Mercury, to which belong Gemini and Virgo; the Moon, to which belongs Cancer; the Sun, to which belongs Leo; Jupiter, to which belong Sagittarius and Pisces; and Saturn, to which belong Capricorn and Aquarius. ﴿وَزَيَّنَّاهَا﴾ with the stars ﴿لِلنَّاظِرِينَ﴾

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَحَفِظْنَاهَا﴾ with shooting flames ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ﴾ stoned

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but ﴿مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ﴾ snatched it ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ a star that shines and burns him, or pierces him, or deranges him.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا﴾ We spread it out ﴿وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ﴾ firm mountains, so that it does not shake with its inhabitants ﴿وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ﴾ known and measured.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ﴾ with yāʾ: of fruits and grains; and We made for you ﴿وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ﴾ such as slaves, riding animals and cattle, for it is Allah alone who provides for them.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ not ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ﴾ the keys of its treasuries ﴿وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ﴾ according to what is beneficial.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ﴾ they fertilise the clouds so that they fill with water ﴿فَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ﴾ the clouds ﴿مَاءً﴾ rain ﴿فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ﴾ i.e. its storehouses are not in your hands.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ﴾ the Everlasting; We inherit all creation.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ﴾ i.e. those of creation who came before, from the time of Adam ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ﴾ those who come later, until the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ﴾ in His making ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ of His creation.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ﴾ Adam ﴿مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ﴾ dry clay which gives a ringing (ṣalṣala), i.e. a sound, when struck ﴿مِنْ حَمَإٍ﴾ black mud ﴿مَسْنُونٍ﴾ altered.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَالْجَانَّ﴾ the father of the jinn, who is Iblīs ﴿خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ i.e. before the creation of Adam ﴿مِنْ نَارِ السَّمُومِ﴾ it is a smokeless fire that penetrates the pores.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿وَ﴾ remember ﴿إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ﴾

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ﴾ I have completed him ﴿وَنَفَخْتُ﴾ and made flow ﴿فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِي﴾ so that he became alive; and the attribution of the spirit to Him is an honouring of Adam ﴿فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ﴾ a prostration of greeting, by bowing.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ﴾ in it there are two emphases (tawkīd).

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ﴾ he is the father of the jinn; he was among the angels ﴿أَبَى﴾ he refused ﴿أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted ﴿يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ﴾ what prevented you ﴿أَ﴾ n ﴿لَا﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: the source splits أَلَّا into ﴿أَ﴾ + نْ + ﴿لَا﴾, i.e. أَنْ followed by a redundant لَا.]

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَسْجُدَ﴾ it is not fitting for me to prostrate ﴿لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ﴾

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا﴾ i.e. from the Garden; and it is said: from the heavens ﴿فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ﴾ banished

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ﴾ the Requital

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ i.e. mankind

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ﴾ the time of the first blowing [of the Trumpet].

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي﴾ i.e. by Your leading me astray; the bāʾ is for the oath, and its answer is ﴿لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ acts of disobedience ﴿وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ i.e. the believers.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted ﴿هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾ and it is [Translator's note: the sentence continues into the next verse].

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿إِنَّ عِبَادِي﴾ i.e. the believers ﴿لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ﴾ power ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but ﴿مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ﴾ the disbelievers.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ i.e. those who follow you, together with you.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ﴾ levels ﴿لِكُلِّ بَابٍ﴾ of them ﴿مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ﴾ a share ﴿مَقْسُومٌ﴾

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ gardens ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ flowing in them; and it will be said to them:

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ﴾ i.e. safe from everything feared; or: with a greeting of peace, i.e. greet [one another] and enter ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ from every fright.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ﴾ rancour ﴿إِخْوَانًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) of "هِمْ" ﴿عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ﴾ also a ḥāl, i.e. none of them looks at the back of another's head, because the couches revolve with them.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ﴾ fatigue ﴿وَمَا هُمْ مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ﴾ ever.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿نَبِّئْ﴾ inform, O Muhammad ﴿عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ﴾ to the believers ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ to them.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي﴾ for the disobedient ﴿هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ﴾ the painful.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ﴾ they were angels, twelve, or ten, or three, among them Jibrīl.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا﴾ i.e. this very word ﴿قَالَ﴾ Ibrāhīm, when he offered them food and they did not eat ﴿إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ﴾ afraid.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿قَالُوا لَا تَوْجَلْ﴾ do not fear ﴿إِنَّا﴾ the messengers of your Lord ﴿نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ﴾ possessed of much knowledge; he is Isḥāq, as we mentioned in Sūrat Hūd.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي﴾ with a son ﴿عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. while it has touched me ﴿فَبِمَ﴾ with what thing then ﴿تُبَشِّرُونَ﴾ a question expressing wonder.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿قَالُوا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with the truth ﴿فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْقَانِطِينَ﴾ the despairing.

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿قَالَ وَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿يَقْنِطُ﴾ with kasra on the nūn, and with fatḥa [يَقْنَطُ] ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ﴾ the disbelievers.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ disbelievers, i.e. the people of Lūṭ, to destroy them.

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ because of their faith.

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ﴾ those remaining in the punishment, because of her disbelief.

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ to them ﴿إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ﴾ I do not know you.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿قَالُوا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوا﴾ i.e. your people ﴿فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ﴾ doubt, and that is the punishment.

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ﴾ in what we say.

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ﴾ walk behind them ﴿وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ﴾ lest he see the terrible thing that befalls them ﴿وَامْضُوا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ﴾ and that is Syria (al-Shām).

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿وَقَضَيْنَا﴾ We revealed ﴿إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرَ﴾ which is ﴿أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. their extermination will be completed in the morning.

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ the city of Sodom (Sadūm), and they were the people of Lūṭ, when they were told that in Lūṭ's house there were handsome beardless youths, and they were the angels ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾ a ḥāl: hoping to commit the indecency with them.

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ﴾ by your setting out to commit the indecency with them.

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿قَالُوا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ from hosting them.

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ﴾ what you want of satisfying desire, then marry them.

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿لَعَمْرُكَ﴾ an address to the Prophet ﷺ, i.e. by your life ﴿إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ wander in confusion.

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ the cry of Jibrīl ﴿مُشْرِقِينَ﴾ at the time of sunrise.

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا﴾ i.e. their towns ﴿سَافِلَهَا﴾ in that Jibrīl raised them to the sky and dropped them upside down onto the earth ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ clay baked by fire.

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ indications of the oneness of Allah ﴿لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ﴾ for those who observe and take lessons.

celaleyn:76-76.t: ﴿وَإِنَّهَا﴾ i.e. the towns of the people of Lūṭ ﴿لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ﴾ the route of Quraysh to Syria; they have not been effaced. Will they then not take a lesson from them?

celaleyn:78-78.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa) [from inna], i.e. "innahu" ﴿كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ﴾ it is a thicket of trees near Madyan, and they were the people of Shuʿayb ﴿لَظَالِمِينَ﴾ by their denial of Shuʿayb.

celaleyn:79-79.t: ﴿فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ﴾ by destroying them with intense heat ﴿وَإِنَّهُمَا﴾ i.e. the towns of the people of Lūṭ and of al-Ayka ﴿لَبِإِمَامٍ﴾ a road ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ clear. Will you then not take a lesson from them, O people of Mecca?

celaleyn:80-80.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ﴾ a valley between Medina and Syria, and they were Thamūd ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ by their denial of Ṣāliḥ, because it is a denial of the rest of the messengers, since they share in bringing [the message of] divine oneness (tawḥīd).

celaleyn:81-81.t: ﴿وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتِنَا﴾ in the she-camel ﴿فَكَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ they did not reflect on them.

celaleyn:82-82.t: ﴿وَكَانُوا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا آمِنِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:83-83.t: ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ at the time of morning.

celaleyn:84-84.t: ﴿فَمَا أَغْنَى﴾ warded off ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ the punishment ﴿مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ of building fortresses and amassing wealth.

celaleyn:85-85.t: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ﴾ inevitably, and everyone will be requited for his deeds ﴿فَاصْفَحِ﴾ O Muhammad, from your people ﴿الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ﴾ turn away from them with a turning away in which there is no distress. This is abrogated by the Verse of the Sword.

celaleyn:86-86.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ﴾ of everything ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of everything.

celaleyn:87-87.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي﴾ he ﷺ said: "It is al-Fātiḥa", narrated by the two Shaykhs [al-Bukhārī and Muslim]; because it is repeated in every rakʿa ﴿وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ﴾

celaleyn:88-88.t: ﴿لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا﴾ categories ﴿مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ if they do not believe ﴿وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ﴾ be gentle ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾

celaleyn:89-89.t: ﴿وَقُلْ إِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ﴾ of Allah's punishment, lest it descend upon you ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ clear in warning.

celaleyn:90-90.t: ﴿كَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا﴾ the punishment ﴿عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ﴾ the Jews and the Christians.

celaleyn:91-91.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ﴾ i.e. their scriptures revealed to them ﴿عِضِينَ﴾ parts, in that they believed in some and disbelieved in some. And it is said: what is meant by them are those who divided the roads of Mecca among themselves, turning people away from Islam; some of them said of the Quran that it was sorcery, some that it was soothsaying, and some that it was poetry.

celaleyn:92-92.t: ﴿فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ a questioning of rebuke.

celaleyn:93-93.t: ﴿عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:94-94.t: ﴿فَاصْدَعْ﴾ O Muhammad ﴿بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ﴾ [with it], i.e. proclaim it openly and carry it out ﴿وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ this was before the command to wage jihad.

celaleyn:95-95.t: ﴿إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ﴾ at you, by Our destroying each of them with an affliction; they were al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, al-ʿĀṣī ibn Wāʾil, ʿAdī ibn Qays, al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib and al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd Yaghūth.

celaleyn:96-96.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); and it is said: a mubtadaʾ (subject), and because it contains the meaning of a condition the fāʾ entered its khabar (predicate), which is ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the outcome of their affair.

celaleyn:97-97.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ for affirmation (taḥqīq) ﴿نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ﴾ of mockery and denial.

celaleyn:98-98.t: ﴿فَسَبِّحْ﴾ joined ﴿بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ﴾ i.e. say "subḥāna Llāhi wa-bi-ḥamdih" ﴿وَكُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ those who pray.

daas-irab:86-91.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿سَبْعاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the response to the oath, and the oath is resumptive speech. ﴿مِنَ الْمَثانِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of سبعا. ﴿وَالْقُرْآنَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿الْعَظِيمَ﴾ naʿt. ﴿لا تَمُدَّنَّ﴾ lā of prohibition and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the verb is in the position of jussive (jazm) by the prohibitive lā, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَيْنَيْكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is dual; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى ما﴾ mā is a relative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تمدن. ﴿مَتَّعْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to متعنا. ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of أزواجا. ﴿وَلا تَحْزَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تحزن. ﴿وَاخْفِضْ جَناحَكَ﴾ an imperative verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخفض. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنَا النَّذِيرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ naʿt. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to آتيناك. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزلنا. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive, naʿt of المقتسمين. ﴿جَعَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عِضِينَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:92-99.t: ﴿فَوَ رَبِّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, the wāw is for the oath, and رب is genitive (majrūr); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أقسم (I swear); the clause has no grammatical position and the speech is resumptive; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَنَسْئَلَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and نسألنهم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause of the response to the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in لنسألهم, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ ʿan is a preposition and mā is a relative. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿فَاصْدَعْ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa) and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِما تُؤْمَرُ﴾ mā is a relative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصدع; تؤمر is a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is the ṣila of mā. ﴿وَأَعْرِضْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to اصدع. ﴿عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعرض. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كَفَيْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative in the position of genitive, naʿt (adjective) of المستهزئين. [Translator's note: المستهزئين is accusative here, so a naʿt of it would be in the position of accusative; the source says "genitive" as written.] ﴿يَجْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of يجعلون. [Translator's note: مع is normally classed as an adverb of place or accompaniment; the source says "of time" as written.] ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلهاً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آخَرَ﴾ naʿt. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and sawfa is a particle of futurity. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿نَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the implied (muqaddar) oath, and the speech is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّكَ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar stand in place of the two objects of نعلم. ﴿يَضِيقُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿صَدْرُكَ﴾ fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يضيق; the clause يضيق is the khabar. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَسَبِّحْ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿بِحَمْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سبح. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكُنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and كن is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb whose noun is omitted, its implied form being "أنت". [Translator's note: the noun of كن is normally described as a latent pronoun (mustatir) rather than omitted; the source says "omitted" as written.] ﴿مِنَ السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاعْبُدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is أنت, a latent pronoun. ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿يَأْتِيَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after ḥattā; the kāf is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْيَقِينُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by ḥattā; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to اعبد. The meaning of اليقين is death.

daas-irab:1-5.t: ﴿الر﴾ these letters have no i'rab. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَقُرْآنٍ﴾ conjoined to الكتاب. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿رُبَما﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَوَدُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَوْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) particle. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿مُسْلِمِينَ﴾ khabar; law and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يود. ﴿ذَرْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَأْكُلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); the fāʿil is the wāw; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ conjoined to يأكلوا and parsed like it. ﴿وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and sawfa is a particle of the future. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and mā is negative. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وَلَها كِتابٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and كتاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar. ﴿مَعْلُومٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿ما تَسْبِقُ﴾ mā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ fāʿil, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿أَجَلَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:6-10.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative, and hā is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, badal (substitute) of أي or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿نُزِّلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نزل. ﴿الذِّكْرُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is the speech. ﴿لَوْ ما﴾ a particle of non-occurrence owing to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and here it is for urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿تَأْتِينا بِالْمَلائِكَةِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تأتينا; the clause has no grammatical position, being resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the apodosis (jawāb) of in is omitted. ﴿ما نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلائِكَةَ﴾ mā is negative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and الملائكة is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of response, with no grammatical position. ﴿مُنْظَرِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَزَّلْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الذِّكْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حافظون. ﴿لَحافِظُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the response of an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, its implied form being "رسلا من قبلك"; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي شِيَعِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a second adjective. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:11-15.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is the negative. ﴿يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿رَسُولٍ﴾ fāʿil (agent), genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستهزئون; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, genitive by the kāf; [they are] attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَسْلُكُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نسلكه. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنون. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿فَتَحْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فتحنا. ﴿باباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of بابا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial. ﴿فَظَلُّوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ẓalla and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعرجون. ﴿يَعْرُجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of ظلوا. ﴿لَقالُوا﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of law, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of law, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصارُنا﴾ a passive past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, أبصارنا is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿مَسْحُورُونَ﴾ an adjective of قوم; the clause, together with what preceded, is the speech.

daas-irab:16-20.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the response of an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعلنا. ﴿بُرُوجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿وَزَيَّنَّاها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلنَّاظِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to زيناها. ﴿وَحَفِظْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حفظناها. ﴿شَيْطانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَجِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شِهابٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and الأرض is mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned. ﴿مَدَدْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause explains the omitted clause, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَلْقَيْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ألقينا. ﴿رَواسِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَأَنْبَتْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنبتنا. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنبتنا. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَوْزُونٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جعلنا. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَعايِشَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ conjoined to معايش. ﴿لَسْتُمْ﴾ laysa and its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رازقين. ﴿بِرازِقِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; رازقين is a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of لستم; the clause is the ṣila of من, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:21-24.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and in is negative. ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عِنْدَنا﴾ an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَزائِنُهُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of شيء. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿نُنَزِّلُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِقَدَرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ننزله. ﴿مَعْلُومٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّياحَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَواقِحَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَنْزَلْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزلنا. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَسْقَيْناكُمُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أسقينا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the kāf is its first object, the mīm marks the plural, the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is its second object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negative, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿بِخازِنِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant, and خازنين is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَنَحْنُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and نحن is mubtadaʾ. ﴿نُحْيِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and its fāʿil is "نحن"; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَنُمِيتُ﴾ conjoined to نحيي. ﴿وَنَحْنُ الْوارِثُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the response of the oath, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response of the oath. ﴿الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المستقدمين. ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ﴾ see the i'rab of لقد علمنا المستقدمين.

daas-irab:25-29.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of هو, and the clause هو يحشرهم is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسانَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ صَلْصالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقنا. ﴿مِنْ حَمَإٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of صلصال. ﴿مَسْنُونٍ﴾ an adjective of حمأ; the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive. ﴿وَالْجَانَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and الجان is mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned. ﴿خَلَقْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause explains the omitted clause, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلقنا. ﴿مِنْ نارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلقناه. ﴿السَّمُومِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿قالَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قال. ﴿إِنِّي خالِقٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿بَشَراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of خالق. ﴿مِنْ صَلْصالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of بشر. ﴿مِنْ حَمَإٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of صلصال. ﴿مَسْنُونٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and idhā is an adverb of future time, governing its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿سَوَّيْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَنَفَخْتُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to سويته. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نفخت. ﴿مِنْ رُوحِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, its implied form being "ونفخت فيه روحا من روحي". ﴿فَقَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of idhā, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn from its end, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قعوا. ﴿ساجِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause of the apodosis of idhā has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:30-35.t: ﴿فَسَجَدَ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿كُلُّهُمْ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَجْمَعُونَ﴾ a second tawkīd, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أَبى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ﴾ the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba). ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, and its noun is omitted, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿إِبْلِيسُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a single proper name, indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the clause is the speech. ﴿أن﴾ the particle of the subjunctive. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the noun of تكون is omitted. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿السَّاجِدِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive. ﴿أَكُنْ﴾ a defective imperfect verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿لِأَسْجُدَ﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of denial; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿لِبَشَرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسجد. ﴿خَلَقْتَهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of بشر. ﴿مِنْ صَلْصالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلقته. ﴿مِنْ حَمَإٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of صلصال. ﴿مَسْنُونٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاخْرُجْ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اخرج. ﴿فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ﴾ inna, and اللعنة is its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الدِّينِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:36-41.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which is omitted for lightness; its appearance is prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel. ﴿فَأَنْظِرْنِي﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); أنظرني is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنظرني. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant, and inna and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المنظرين. ﴿الْوَقْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمَعْلُومِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿قالَ رَبِّ﴾ see its i'rab at the start of the verse. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya). ﴿أَغْوَيْتَنِي﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; it is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the omitted verb أقسم ("I swear"); the clause is the speech. ﴿لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response of the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أزينن. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أزينن. ﴿وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ﴾ parsed like لأزينن, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عِبادَكَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, accusative, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المخلصين. ﴿الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ an adjective of عبادك, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذا﴾ hā is for alerting (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿صِراطٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is the speech. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾ a second adjective of صراط.

daas-irab:42-47.t: ﴿إِنَّ عِبادِي﴾ inna, and عبادي is its noun, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is explicative. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of laysa. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of laysa. ﴿سُلْطانٌ﴾ the noun of laysa; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿اتَّبَعَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الْغاوِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اتبعك; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ﴾ khabar, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿لَها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿سَبْعَةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَبْوابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿بابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿جُزْءٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَقْسُومٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ inna and its noun, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ conjoined to جنات; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْخُلُوها﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "يقال لهم ادخلوها" («it will be said to them: Enter it»). ﴿بِسَلامٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿وَنَزَعْنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي صُدُورِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿مِنْ غِلٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿إِخْواناً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿عَلى سُرُرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متقابلين. ﴿مُتَقابِلِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:48-52.t: ﴿لا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيها نَصَبٌ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يمسهم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿هُمْ﴾ its noun. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مخرجين. ﴿بِمُخْرَجِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and مخرجين is genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā; the clause is conjoined. ﴿نَبِّئْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عِبادِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنِّي﴾ anna and its noun; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) takes the place of the fāʿil of نبىء. «[Translator's note: so in the source ("the fāʿil"); the interpreted maṣdar is usually said to take the place of the remaining objects of نبئ.]» ﴿أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿وَأَنَّ عَذابِي﴾ anna and its noun, parsed like عبادي; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هُوَ الْعَذابُ الْأَلِيمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and الأليم is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿وَنَبِّئْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنْ ضَيْفِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نبئهم. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to نبئهم. ﴿دَخَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to دخلوا. ﴿فَقالُوا سَلاماً﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined; and سلاما is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "سلم سلاما". ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and منكم is attached to وجلون; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:53-57.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَوْجَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿نُبَشِّرُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بِغُلامٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نبشرك. ﴿عَلِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي﴾ the hamza is interrogative; a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ) and the nūn for protection (wiqāya); the clause is the speech. ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) particle. ﴿مَسَّنِيَ﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْكِبَرُ﴾ fāʿil; an and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by على, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to بشرتموني. ﴿فَبِمَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and mā is an interrogative noun, genitive by the bāʾ, its alif dropped because the preposition enters upon it; [they are] attached to تبشرون. ﴿تُبَشِّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَشَّرْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بشرناك. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, whose noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْقانِطِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَقْنَطُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقنط. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الضَّالُّونَ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and mā is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَطْبُكُمْ﴾ khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; the vocative particle is omitted, and the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الْمُرْسَلُونَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of أي or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:58-62.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna, and nā is its noun; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أُرْسِلْنا﴾ a passive past verb, and nā is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا. ﴿إِلى قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿آلَ﴾ accusative (manṣūb) as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) from قوم. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna, and nā is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); منجوهم is the khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm marks the plural. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَهُ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا from آل لوط, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدَّرْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّها﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ الْغابِرِينَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar of inna; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; lammā is an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna). ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿آلَ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمُرْسَلُونَ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مُنْكَرُونَ﴾ an adjective of قوم; the clause is the speech.

daas-irab:63-65.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿جِئْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative, and the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئناك. ﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يمترون. ﴿يَمْتَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿وَأَتَيْناكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna, and nā is its noun. ﴿لَصادِقُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); صادقون is the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فَأَسْرِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and أسر is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِأَهْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بِقِطْعٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسر. ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of قطع. ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; it is conjoined to أسر. ﴿أَدْبارَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا يَلْتَفِتْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive, and the imperfect verb is jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾ the fāʿil of يلتفت. ﴿وَامْضُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to امضوا. ﴿تُؤْمَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:66-70.t: ﴿وَقَضَيْنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قضينا. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿الْأَمْرَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿أَنَّ دابِرَ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh); أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿مَقْطُوعٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of anna; the clause is in the position of accusative as a badal of الأمر. ﴿مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ. ﴿وَجاءَ أَهْلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ hā is for alerting, and أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿ضَيْفِي﴾ khabar, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَفْضَحُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, by the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness, is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا تُخْزُونِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā, by the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is a conjunction, and lam is jussive. ﴿نَنْهَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the clause is the speech. ﴿عَنِ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ننهك.

daas-irab:71-77.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ hā is for alerting (tanbīh), and أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَناتِي﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿فاعِلِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the apodosis (jawāb) of in is omitted, its implied form being "فتزوجوهن" («then marry them»). ﴿لَعَمْرُكَ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and عمرك is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "قسمي" («is my oath»). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعمهون; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُشْرِقِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَجَعَلْنا عالِيَها سافِلَها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the hāʾ in both objects is in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجارَةً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and عليهم is attached to أمطرنا. ﴿مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of حجارة; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf for address, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to آيات; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām; آيات is the noun of inna, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَإِنَّها﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَبِسَبِيلٍ﴾ the shifted lām, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the khabar of inna. ﴿مُقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ parsed like إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين; the meaning of المتوسمين is: people of reflection and perspicacity.

daas-irab:78-83.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and in is lightened from inna, its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانَ أَصْحابُ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿الْأَيْكَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الأيكة means trees. ﴿لَظالِمِينَ﴾ the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause of kāna is the khabar of in. ﴿فَانْتَقَمْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, its implied form being "أسرفوا بالإثم فانتقمنا" («they went to excess in sin, so We took retribution»). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) انتقمنا. ﴿وَإِنَّهُما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun. ﴿لَبِإِمامٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); بإمام is attached to the khabar. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of إمام; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبَ أَصْحابُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْحِجْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; آتيناهم is a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿آياتِنا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَكانُوا عَنْها مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَنْحِتُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الْجِبالِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fronted mafʿūl bihi, and الصيحة is its postponed fāʿil, and مصبحين is a ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ.

daas-irab:84-85.t: ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; mā is negative. ﴿أَغْنى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أغنى. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption and mā is negative. ﴿خَلَقْنَا السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is a relative noun conjoined to what preceded, and it is accusative. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of السموات. ﴿وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَآتِيَةٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آتية is the khabar of inna. ﴿فَاصْفَحِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition); اصفح is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الصَّفْحَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿الْجَمِيلَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

dervis-irab:65-77.t:
* Vocabulary:
(فَأَسْرِ): with the hamza of disjunction (hamzat al-qaṭʿ), from أسرى; it was also read with the hamza of conjunction (hamzat al-waṣl), from سرى. One says سرى بالليل and أسرى, and سريت به and أسريت به ("I travelled with him by night"), and طال بهم السّرى ("the night journey was long for them") as well as طالت [in the feminine]; [السّرى] may be a maṣdar (verbal noun) like الهدى, or the plural of سرية. One says: سرينا سرية من الليل ("we travelled a stretch of the night"), with سرية and سُرية like غَرفة and غُرفة. Abū Zayd recited:
وأرفع صدر العنس وهي شملّة ... إذا ما السرى مالت بلوث العمائم
(I raise the breast of the sturdy, swift she-camel when the night journey has made the turbans of the riders droop.)
(يَعْمَهُونَ): they wander in confusion; it has been mentioned before.
(سِجِّيلٍ): clay baked by fire.
(لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ): for those who read signs (al-mutafarrisīn), who take heed and reflect. التوسم is on the pattern تفعّل from الوسم; the original sense of التوسم is to verify and reflect, taken from الوسم, which is branding with a piece of iron on the hide of a cow or another animal. Thaʿlab said: al-wāsim is the one who looks you over from the parting of your hair to your feet.
(القطع): its explanation has preceded; it only applies to the last part of the night. The poet said:
افتحي الباب وانظري في النجوم ... كم علينا من قطع ليل بهيم
(Open the door and look at the stars: how much of the pitch-dark night still remains upon us?)

* I'rab:
(فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that implies an omitted condition); (أسر) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; (بأهلك) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (بقطع) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أسر); (من الليل) is a naʿt (adjective) of (قطع). (وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبارَهُمْ وَلا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ): (واتبع) is conjoined to (فأسر); (أدبارهم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (يلتفت) is jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (منكم) is a ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective [of أحد]; (أحد) is the fāʿil; (امضوا) is also conjoined; (حيث) is a vague adverb in the position of accusative as the object of (امضوا) — because of its vagueness the verb is made transitive to it without an intermediary — and the clause (تؤمرون) is the muḍāf ilayhi to which the adverb is annexed. (وَقَضَيْنا إِلَيْهِ ذلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دابِرَ هؤُلاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ): (وقضينا) is a verb and its agent; (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «قفينا» [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently a misprint for «قضينا»] because it carries the sense of «أوحينا» ("We revealed"); (ذلك) is the object of «ففينا» [Translator's note: so in the source; again for «قضينا»]; (الأمر) is a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is an interpreted maṣdar, a badal for (ذلك الأمر), or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). Its being left vague and then explained magnifies the matter and exalts its import. (أنّ) and its noun; (مقطوع) is its khabar; (مصبحين) is a ḥāl from the pronoun settled in (مقطوع), and it is made plural according to the meaning, so that (مقطوع) means "cut off" in the plural. (وَجاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ): the wāw is a conjunction; (جاء أهل المدينة) is a verb and its agent; the clause (يستبشرون) is a ḥāl. (قالَ إِنَّ هؤُلاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلا تَفْضَحُونِ): (إنّ), its noun and its khabar; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; (لا) is prohibitive; (تفضحوني) is jussive by (لا); the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ, omitted out of regard for the verse-endings, is the mafʿūl bihi. (وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلا تُخْزُونِ): conjoined to what preceded; the i'rab of a parallel has already been given. (قالُوا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعالَمِينَ): the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw conjoins to something omitted; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of the tense] and jussive mood; (ننهك) is an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم); the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; (عن العالمين) is attached to (ننهك). The soundest of the views about his being forbidden [concerning] "the worlds" is that he was forbidden to grant protection to any of them and to stand between them and his people. (قالَ هؤُلاءِ بَناتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فاعِلِينَ): (هؤلاء بناتي) is a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and something omitted must be supplied, i.e. «فانكحوهن» ("so marry them"). It is also possible that (هؤلاء) is a mafʿūl bihi of an implied verb, i.e. «انكحوا هؤلاء» ("marry these"), with (بناتي) as a badal. (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is kāna and its noun, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (فاعلين) is the khabar of (كنتم); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of (إن) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, the omitted [element], i.e. «فانكحوهن». (لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ): the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ); (عمرك) is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is necessarily omitted, implied as «قسمي» ("is my oath"); the clause (إنهم …) is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position; (إنّ) and its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (في سكرتهم) is attached to (يعمهون); the clause (يعمهون) is the khabar of (إنهم); and the whole clause (لعمرك إنهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون) is parenthetical. (فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أخذتهم الصيحة) is a verb, a direct object and an agent; (مشرقين) is a ḥāl, i.e. entering upon sunrise, which is the rising of the sun. (فَجَعَلْنا عالِيَها سافِلَها وَأَمْطَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the conjoining follows upon the seizing by the Cry; (جعلنا) is a verb and its agent; (عاليها) is the first object of (جعلنا) and (سافلها) its second object; (أمطرنا) is conjoined to (جعلنا); (حجارة) is a mafʿūl bihi; (عليهم) is attached to (أمطرنا); (من سجيل) is an adjective of (حجارة). (إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ): (إنّ) is a particle resembling the verb; (في ذلك) is its fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām; (آيات) is its noun; (للمتوسمين) is an adjective of (آيات), or it is attached to (الآيات) itself, since it means "signs/marks". (وَإِنَّها لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ): (إنّ) and its noun — the pronoun refers to the city, which is Sodom, and what is meant is its remains; the lām is the shifted lām; (بسبيل) is its khabar; (مقيم) is an adjective, i.e. established and travelled, known to people. In it is an alert to Quraysh: you pass by it every day. (إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ): the i'rab of its parallel has preceded.

* Rhetoric:
The noble verse «فأسر بأهلك بقطع من الليل واتبع أدبارهم ولا يلتفت منكم أحد وامضوا حيث تؤمرون», for all its concision, comprises the etiquette of travellers setting out for an important religious or worldly matter — of the one who commands and the one commanded, the follower and the followed. We shall summarise the etiquette contained in it:
1- He commanded him to put them in front of him, so that his heart would not be occupied with those behind him, and so that he could keep watch over them and their circumstances.
2- He set the night journey in the last part of the night, because it is more concealed «للويل» [Translator's note: so in the source; the word appears corrupt] and because a person is energetic at that time.
3- He forbade them to turn around, which hinders the one hastening on his night journey in that terrifying, perilous situation, and so that they would not see the punishment that befell their people and their hearts soften towards them.
4- And so that none of them would lag behind for some purpose and be struck by the punishment; and because one who turns around always stops, remembers his old haunts and pastures, and grieves and sorrows, and the sobbing may persist, as happened to al-Ṣimma ibn ʿAbd Allāh:
تلفت نحو الحي حتى وجدتني ... وجعت من الإصغاء ليتا واخدعا
(I kept turning towards the encampment until I found my neck-sides and neck-veins aching from straining to look.)
And as happened to al-Sharīf al-Raḍī:
ولقد وقفت على ديارهم ... وطلولها بيد البلى نهب
وبكيت حتى ضج من لغب ... نضوي ولج بعذلي الركب
وتلفتت عيني فمذ خفيت ... عني الطلول تلفت القلب
(I stood at their dwellings, whose ruins are plundered by the hand of decay; I wept until my lean mount groaned with fatigue and the riders persisted in blaming me; my eye kept turning back, and once the ruins were hidden from me, my heart turned back.)

* Benefits:
Among the proverbs of the Arabs is «أجور من قاضي سدوم» ("more unjust than the judge of Sadūm"). They said: [Sadūm], with a fatḥa on the sīn, is one of the cities of the people of Lot. Al-Azharī said: Abū Ḥātim said in the book he composed on corrupted and debased [usage]: it is only «سذوم» with a dotted dhāl, and the [undotted] dāl is a mistake. Al-Azharī said: in my view this is correct. Al-Ṭabarī said: "He was a tyrannical king, of the remnants of the Greeks, in the city of Sarmīn in the land of Qinnasrīn." This is what the author of al-Qāmūs relied upon, and it led him to fault al-Jawharī. Al-Thaʿālibī said: Sadūm was one of the ancient kings characterised by injustice, «كالة» [Translator's note: so in the source; the word appears corrupt] a judge more unjust than he. Al-Zabīdī said: "It is known from what has preceded that the proverb is recorded both ways, and that the well-known form has the undotted dāl." And he reported from al-Shihāb that it may originally have been with the dotted [dhāl] before it was Arabicised, and when it was Arabicised they left its dāl undotted.

dervis-irab:78-85.t:
* Vocabulary:
(الْأَيْكَةِ): a thicket of trees near «المدينة» ("the city") [Translator's note: probably Madyan is meant], and its people are the people of Shuʿayb. In al-Mukhtār: الأيك is dense, abundant trees; the singular is أيكة, like تمر and تمرة.
(الْحِجْرِ): a valley between Medina and Syria; they are the people of Thamūd.

* I'rab:
