The clause «إنّك من المنظرين» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you want the respite, then you are among those granted respite", and the implied conditional clause is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
(إلى يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المنظرين. (الوقت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (المعلوم) naʿt of الوقت, genitive.

safi-cedvel:39-40.t:
* I'rab
(قال ربّ) their i'rab has already been given [[in verse 36.]]. (الباء) a preposition [[it is causal according to some commentators, because swearing by the leading astray is not customary; and it is the bāʾ of oath according to others, because leading astray can be sworn by as being an act of Allah ...]]. (ما) a maṣdar particle. (أغويتني) a past verb together with its fāʿil.. and (النون) is protective and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (اللام) the lām of oath. (أزيّننّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative, and (النون) is for emphasis; the fāʿil is "I". (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أزيّننّ). (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the implied object of أزيّننّ, that is: "I will surely make disobedience appear attractive to them, existing on the earth" [[or a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لهم).]].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أغويتني) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear", that is: "I swear by Your leading me astray that I will surely make attractive" [[see verse (16) of Sūrat al-Aʿrāf, which is the counterpart of this one in i'rab, and in it there is further clarification regarding the attachment of the bāʾ and the permissibility of making it causal.]].
(الواو) conjunction. (لأغوينّهم) like لأزيّننّ, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (أجمعين) tawkīd of the third-person pronoun هم, accusative (or a ḥāl from it), its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «the vocative and its answer» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أغويتني» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar particle (ما).
The clause «أزيننّ لهم ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the oath.. and the oath clause with its answer is the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أغوينّهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the oath-answer clause.
(إلّا) a particle of exception. (عبادك) the excepted, accusative.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from عبادك. (المخلصين) naʿt of عبادك, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.

* Benefits:
- His saying: رَبِّ بِما أَغْوَيْتَنِي.
Some grammarians considered the «باء» to be the bāʾ of oath, as if he were saying: "I swear by Your leading me astray". We do not hold this opinion; the bāʾ here is causal, for he is saying: "I will make things attractive to them on the earth and lead them all astray because of Your leading me astray". The meaning on this reading is closer to the Arabic natural disposition and dispenses with an implied element for which there is no need.

safi-cedvel:41-44.t:
* I'rab
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "He". (ها) a particle of alerting. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (صراط) khabar, nominative. (على) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an adjective of صراط. (مستقيم) a second naʿt, nominative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «هذا صراط ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb. (عبادي) the ism of إنّ, accusative, its accusative marking being the implied fatḥa on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (ليس) a defective, inert past verb. (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the khabar of ليس. (عليهم) like عليّ, attached to a ḥāl from سلطان (an adjective that preceded the described noun). (سلطان) the postponed ism of ليس. (إلّا) a particle of exception. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as a discontinuous exception [[it is said that it is an exception because the servants are all those held to account, and from them are excepted those who followed Satan.. As for its being discontinuous, it is because Satan has no authority over all the servants; and their following him is by his making things attractive.]]. (اتّبعك) a past verb, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "he", which is the returning pronoun. (من الغاوين) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the pronoun of the fāʿil.
The clause «إنّ عبادي ليس ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the preceding saying.
The clause «ليس لك.. سلطان» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّ جهنّم) like إنّ عبادي; جهنّم is withheld from tanwīn because of being a proper name and feminine. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (موعدهم) khabar of إنّ, nominative..
and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (أجمعين) tawkīd for the pronoun in موعدهم, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ جهنّم لموعدهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّ عبادي..
(لها) like لك, attached to a fronted khabar. (سبعة) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (أبواب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. (باب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from (جزء) [[جزء in the sense of a group or party.
(2, 3) it is permissible for it to be resumptive, in which case it has no position.]], which is a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (مقسوم) naʿt of جزء, nominative.
The clause «لها سبعة أبواب» is in the position of a nominative, a second khabar of (إنّ) «2».
The clause «لكلّ باب.. جزء ...» is in the position of a nominative, naʿt of سبعة أبواب, and the linking element is implied, that is: "for every door of them" «3».

* Morphology:
(جزء): a noun for a part of a thing, from جزأ يجزأ (of the bāb of fatḥa); its wazn is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn; its plural is أجزاء, on the wazn أفعال. Like الجزء with ḍamma are الجزء with fatḥa and also الجزاء with fatḥa.
(مقسوم): a passive participle of the triliteral قسم; its wazn is مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision (ījāz): in His saying, the Exalted, قالَ هذا صِراطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ, and perhaps it is among the most eloquent concisions, because it is the counterpart of concision by omission; it is concision by implication (ījāz bi-l-taqdīr). It is of two kinds: one in which the expression equals its meaning, and the other in which the meaning exceeds the expression, called qaṣr (compression), since its expression indicates numerous possibilities and many contents that cannot be expressed in the like of its words and their number; indeed this is impossible. His saying «هذا» is a pointer indicating nearness, as if he is pointing to what is before their eyes, within their hearing, and within reach of their hands; and صراط indicates the trodden road which leads whoever walks it to whichever of the paths he chooses for himself; but a road may be crooked, twisting, with many bends, so the traveller gets lost in its wildernesses and the means of guidance become confused for him in walking it; so He brought the word «مستقيم», and the straight is the shortest distance between two points, and the least deviation takes it out of the norms and limits of straightness. The word «علي» means obligation and necessity; you say "عليّ the covenant of Allah that I will do so", so you sense that you have bound yourself to what is a right that must be performed. Then the pointer contained everything that the exception afterwards contains, namely His saying إِلَّا عِبادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ, as if He had taken upon Himself and made binding on His own Self a right from which there is no release, namely to deliver the sincere ones from his leading astray.
2- Mockery (tahakkum):
His saying, Glorified and Exalted, إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ. It is not hidden what there is in making Hell their appointed place of mockery and metaphor, as if they were on an appointment; and in it also is a pointer that what has been prepared for them in it is beyond description in its horror.

safi-cedvel:45-48.t:
* I'rab
(إنّ المتّقين) like إنّ عبادي [[in verse (42) of this sura.]]; the accusative marking in المتّقين is the yāʾ. (في جنّات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ. (عيون) conjoined to جنّات by the wāw, genitive.
The clause «إنّ المتّقين في جنّات» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(ادخلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بسلام) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the fāʿil. (آمنين) a second ḥāl [[this is if السلام means greeting; but if السلام means safety and the opposite of fear, then it is permissible for (آمنين) to be a badal from the first ḥāl.]] from the pronoun of the fāʿil, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «ادخلوها ...» is in the position of an accusative, being the content of an implied saying, that is: "the angels say to them: enter it..".
(الواو) conjunction. (نزعنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (في صدورهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما ...
and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (من غلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the returning pronoun in the implied ṣila. (إخوانا) a ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in صدورهم [[because the muḍāf is part of the muḍāf ilayhi; and it is permissible for it to be a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ادخلوها, as al-ʿUkbarī said; and it is permissible for a ḥāl to come inert because it is qualified.]]. (على سرر) a preposition and its genitive noun, naʿt of (إخوانا). (متقابلين) a second naʿt, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «نزعنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(لا) negative. (يمسّهم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the verb يمسّ. (نصب) fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative, working like ليس. (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, the ism of ما. (منها) like فيها, attached to (مخرجين). (الباء) a redundant preposition. (مخرجين) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «لا يمسّهم.. نصب» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in متقابلين [[or it has no position; resumptive..]].
The clause «ما هم منها بمخرجين» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.

* Morphology:
(سرر): plural of سرير, a noun for what one sits upon, made comfortable for delight (surūr); it is taken from it because it is a seat of delight; its wazn is فعيل.
(متقابلين): plural of متقابل, an active participle of the quinqueliteral تقابل; its wazn is متفاعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(مخرجين): plural of مخرج, a passive participle of the quadriliteral أخرج; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:49-52.t:
* I'rab
(نبّئ) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (عبادي) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the implied fatḥa on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (أنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of أنّ. (أنا) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ [[or a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative, as tawkīd of the ism of أنّ, borrowed for the position of the accusative; and its being a separator (faṣl) is weak because what comes after it would not be confused with an adjective.]]. (الغفور) khabar, nominative. (الرحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي أنا الغفور..) is in the position of an accusative, standing in for the second and third objects of the verb نبّأ.
The clause «نبّئ ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أنا الغفور ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (أنّ عذابي هو العذاب الأليم) like أنّي أنا الغفور الرحيم.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن عذابي ... ) is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «هو العذاب ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (نبّئهم) like the first.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عن ضيف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبّئ). (إبراهيم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, its genitive marking being the fatḥa.
The clause «نبّئهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause نبّئ عبادي.
(إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, attached to (ضيف) [[by its being a maṣdar.. or attached to an omitted muḍāf, that is: "about the report of the guests of Ibrāhīm when they entered ..."]].
(دخلوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (دخلوا). (الفاء) conjunction. (قالوا) like دخلوا. (سلاما) mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, that is: "We greet with a greeting". (قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he". (إنّا) like إنّي. (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (وجلون), which is the khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «دخلوا ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause دخلوا.
The clause «(نسلّم) سلاما» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّا منكم ووجلون» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.

* Morphology:
(ضيف): a noun for the visitor. The original of ضيف is a maṣdar, which is why the singular and plural are alike in it in most of their speech; it may also be pluralised as أضياف, ضيوف and ضيفان. The wazn of ضيف is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(وجلون): plural of وجل, a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from وجل يوجل (of the bāb of فرح); its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then kasra.

* Benefits:
- That the verse نَبِّئْ عِبادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ occurs on the metre of the baḥr al-mujtathth is no proof that the noble Qur'an is poetry, because that occurred incidentally, not intended in itself, and there is nothing to prevent the metre of poetry from fitting it.
This leads us to touch upon the metres of poetry and their names. Al-Akhfash said: I asked al-Khalīl: why was the ṭawīl called ṭawīl? He said: because it is long (ṭāla) with the completeness of its parts. I said: and the basīṭ? He said: because it extends (inbasaṭa) beyond the range of the ṭawīl. I said: and the wāfir? He said: for the abundance (wufūr) of its parts, peg upon peg. I said: and the kāmil? He said: because it has thirty vowelled letters (ḥaraka) that are not combined in any other poetry. I said: and the hazaj? He said: because it is agitated, like the hazaj of a voice. I said: and the rajaz? He said: because of its agitation, like the agitation of a she-camel's legs when she stands. I said: and the raml? He said: because it is "tripped" (yarmulu) by joining some to others. I said: and the sarīʿ? He said: because it hastens (yusriʿu) on the tongue. I said: and the munsariḥ? He said: for its flowing (insirāḥ) and ease. I said: and the khafīf? He said: because it is the lightest of the seven-part metres. I said: and the muqtaḍab? He said: because it was cut off (uqtuḍiba) from the sarīʿ. I said: and the muḍāriʿ? He said: because it resembles (ḍāraʿa) the muqtaḍab. I said: and the mujtathth? He said: because it was uprooted (ujtutha), that is cut off, from the long circle. I said: and the mutaqārib? He said: for the closeness (taqārub) of its parts, because they are all five-letter feet resembling one another.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (توجل) an imperfect verb, jussive; the fāʿil is "you". (إنّا) like إنّي [[in verse (49) of this sura.]]. (نبشّرك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "We". (بغلام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبشّر). (عليم) naʿt of غلام, genitive.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا توجل ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «إنّا نبشّرك ...» has no grammatical position; a causal resumption.
The clause «نبشّرك ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
- Majāz mursal (unrestricted figurative usage): in His saying, the Exalted, قالُوا لا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلامٍ عَلِيمٍ.
A human being is not born a boy knowledgeable of affairs; he is born an infant who knows nothing, and these two words were applied to him in view of what he will become.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he". (الهمزة) for interrogation of astonishment. (بشّرتم) a past verb together with its fāʿil, and (الواو) is redundant, the filling out of the vowel of the mīm, and (النون) is protective and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (على) a preposition. (أن) a maṣdar particle. (مسّني) a past verb, and (النون) is protective, and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (الكبر) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن مسّني..) is in the position of a genitive by (على), attached to a ḥāl from the first-person pronoun, that is: "Have you given me good news while I am old?".
(الفاء) conjunction. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تبشّرون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marking being the retention of the nūn..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «أبشّرتموني ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «مسّني الكبر ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar particle (أن).
The clause «تبشّرون» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the content of the saying.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (بشّرنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشرنا). (الفاء) conjunction, linking the effect to the cause. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (تكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive, its ism a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you". (من القانطين) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of تكن, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «بشّرناك ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «لا تكن ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to a causal resumption, that is: "be alert, and do not be among the despairing".

* Morphology:
(القانطين): plural of القانط, an active participle of the triliteral قنط; its wazn is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he". (الواو) conjunction. (من) an interrogative noun containing the sense of negation, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (يقنط) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". (من رحمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقنط). (ربّه) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (إلّا) for exception. (الضالّون) badal from the fāʿil of يقنط, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «من يقنط ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the implied clause that is the content of the saying, that is: "he said: I do not despair, and who despairs ..."
The clause «يقنط ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

* Benefits:
- «من»: the grammarians agree that من is originally for asking about a rational person, as in «من فعل هذا؟» ("Who did this?"). It may be infused with the sense of rhetorical negation, as in: مَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ, and of that is the verse before us: «وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ؟!».
And من comes conditional, as in His saying, the Exalted: مَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً يُجْزَ بِهِ. And it may come as an indefinite qualified noun, and that is when it is followed by a singular, or preceded by the governing «رُبَّ», as in «رأيت من محبّا لك», that is, "a person who loves you". Of this is the saying of Ḥassān ibn Thābit:
فكفى بنا فضلا على من غيرنا ... حب النبي محمد إيانا
(It suffices us as a merit above others: the love of the Prophet Muḥammad for us.) That is: "above a people other than us".

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab
(قال) like the preceding [[in verse (56).]]. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (خطبكم) khabar, nominative.. and (كم) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (أيّها) the one addressed, a specific indefinite, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative..
and (ها) is a particle of alerting. (المرسلون) naʿt of أيّ (or a badal) following it in the nominative in form, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ما خطبكم ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you came for a reason other than the glad tidings, then what is your business".. and the condition clause with its apodosis is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أيّها المرسلون» has no grammatical position; a parenthetical appended remark (iʿtirāḍ tadhyīlī).

* Morphology:
(خطبكم): a noun meaning "affair"; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:58-60.t:
* I'rab
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb..
and (نا) is the ism of إنّ. (أرسلنا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on sukūn..
and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, nāʾib fāʿil. (إلى قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا). (مجرمين) naʿt of قوم, genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّا أرسلنا ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
(إلّا) a particle of exception. (آل) the excepted, accusative, continuous or discontinuous [[the apparent is that it is discontinuous, because the excepted-from is (قوم مجرمين).]]. (لوط) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّا) like the first. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (منجّوهم) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.. and (هم) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (أجمعين) semantic tawkīd for the third-person pronoun in (منجّوهم), genitive, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّا لمنجّوهم ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
(إلّا امرأته) like إلّا آل.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the exception is from آل لوط. (قدّرنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (إنّها) like إنّا. (اللام) like the first. (من الغابرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ, its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قدّرنا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّها لمن الغابرين» is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi of the verb قدّرنا, which is infused with the meaning "We knew" and is suspended (muʿallaq) by (إنّ) with kasra on the hamza because the lām occurs in its khabar.

* Morphology:
(منجّوهم): plural of المنجّي or منجٍ, an active participle of the quadriliteral نجّى; its wazn is مفعٍّ [Translator's note: the source prints «مفع»; the doubled ʿayn of مفعّ appears to have been lost in printing], and it contains an iʿlāl by deletion because of the meeting of two sukūns by reason of the tanwīn; the wazn of منجّوهم is مفعّوهم with ḍamma on the wāw, because it is a defective noun (manqūṣ).

safi-cedvel:61-62.t:
* I'rab
(الفاء) resumptive. (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, attached to (قال). (جاء) a past verb. (آل) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (لوط) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (المرسلون) fāʿil, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «جاء ... المرسلون» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
(قال) like جاء. (إنّكم) like إنّا [[in verse (58) of this sura.]]. (قوم) khabar of إنّ, nominative. (منكرون) naʿt of قوم, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّكم قوم ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.

* Morphology:
(منكرون): plural of منكر, a passive participle of the quadriliteral أنكر; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn [[and see verse (104) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān; there it is a noun and here it is an adjective.]].

safi-cedvel:63-65.t:
* I'rab
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (بل) for transitional iḍrāb. (جئناك) a past verb together with its fāʿil.. and (الكاف) is mafʿūl bihi. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (جئناك). (كانوا) a defective past verb together with its ism. (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يمترون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.. and the content of the saying is omitted, its implied form being "We are not deniers".
The clause «جئناك ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يمترون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
(الواو) conjunction. (أتيناك) like جئناك. (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أتينا, that is: "accompanied by the truth", or from its object, that is: "accompanied by it". (الواو) conjunction. (إنّا) like the preceding [[in verse (58) of this sura.]]. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (صادقون) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw.
(الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (أسر) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is "you". (بأهلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أسر) [[or to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil.]].. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (بقطع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أسر). (من الليل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of قطع. (الواو) conjunction. (اتّبع) like أسر. (أدبارهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (يلتفت) an imperfect verb, jussive. (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from (أحد) (an adjective that preceded the described noun). (أحد) fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (امضوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (حيث) an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative, attached to (امضوا). (تؤمرون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «أتيناك ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جئناك.
The clause «إنّا لصادقون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أتيناك [[or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أتيناك.]].
The clause «أسر ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied condition, that is: "if you want deliverance from your people, then travel by night with your family"..
The clause «اتّبع ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أسر.
The clause «لا يلتفت منكم أحد» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause اتّبع ...
The clause «امضوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا يلتفت منكم أحد ...
The clause «تأمرون [Translator's note: the closing quotation mark is missing in the source] in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.

* Morphology:
(امضوا): it contains an iʿlāl by deletion, for the sake of the meeting of two sukūns; its original is امضيوا, the yāʾ having been dropped after its vowel was moved to the ḍād.

* Rhetoric:
- Kināya: in His saying, the Exalted, وَلا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ, it is possible that the meaning is "let none of you turn away, nor lag behind for some purpose, lest there befall him what befalls the criminals". So "turning" (iltifāt) is figurative, because turning to a thing requires love of it and not leaving it, so that one lags behind at it; or the prohibition against turning is made a kināya for continuing the journey and abandoning slackness and stopping, for whoever looks about must make at least a short pause in doing so.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab
(الواو) resumptive. (قضينا) like جئنا [[in verse (63) of this sura.]]. (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (قضينا), which is infused with the meaning "We revealed". (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.. and (اللام) indicates distance and (الكاف) indicates address. (الأمر) badal from ذا (or ʿaṭf bayān). (أنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative. (دابر) the ism of أنّ, accusative. (ها) a particle of alerting. (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (مقطوع) khabar, nominative. (مصبحين) ḥāl, accusative, from the latent pronoun in مقطوع [[the "rear" of these is in the sense of "the rears of these", so مقطوع is in the sense of مقطوعين, which is why the ḥāl came in the plural form.]], its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ دابر.. مقطوع) is in the position of an accusative, a badal from الأمر. The clause «قضينا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مقطوع): a passive participle of the triliteral قطع; its wazn is مفعول.
(مصبحين): plural of مصبح, an active participle of the quadriliteral أصبح; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab
(الواو) resumptive. (جاء) a past verb. (أهل) fāʿil, nominative. (المدينة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (يستبشرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «جاء أهل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يستبشرون» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from أهل.

safi-cedvel:68-69.t:
* I'rab
(قال) a past verb; the fāʿil is "he", that is Lūṭ. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, a naskh particle. (هؤلاء) an alerting particle and a demonstrative in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (ضيفي) khabar of إنّ, nominative, its nominative marking being the implied ḍamma on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (لا) prohibitive and jussive. (تفضحون) an imperfect verb, jussive, its jussive marking being the dropping of the nūn.. and (النون) is protective, and before it (الواو) is the fāʿil and (الياء), dropped to match the end of the verse, is mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّ هؤلاء ضيفي ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «لا تفضحون ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you honour me, then do not disgrace me", and the implied conditional clause is a resumption within the scope of the saying.
(الواو) conjunction. (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (لا تخزون) like لا تفضحون.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تفضحون.
The clause «لا تخزون» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تفضحون or the clause اتّقوا.

* Morphology:
(تخزون): it contains an iʿlāl by sukūn and an iʿlāl by deletion. Its original is تخزيون (with ḍamma on the yāʾ); the ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ, so it was given sukūn and its vowel was moved to the zāy (iʿlāl by sukūn); then two sukūns met, the yāʾ and the wāw, so the yāʾ was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, and it became تخزون, its wazn being تفعون.

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab
(قالوا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (الهمزة) for interrogation. (الواو) conjunction. (لم) a particle of negation and jussive. (ننهك) an imperfect verb, jussive, its jussive marking being the dropping of the weak letter.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "We". (عن العالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ننهك) with an omitted muḍāf, that is: "from the hospitality of the peoples of the worlds", its genitive marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لم ننهك ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the implied clause that is the content of the saying, that is: "Did We not warn you and forbid you from the worlds" [[or it is the clause that is the content of the saying, with the wāw redundant.]].

safi-cedvel:71-71.t:
* I'rab
(قال هؤلاء بناتي) like قال إنّ هؤلاء ضيفي [[in verse (68) of this sura.]]; and here it is a mubtadaʾ and khabar [[and in the speech there is an omission, that is: "so marry them.. and it is permissible for (بناتي) to be a badal from the demonstrative with an omitted khabar, its implied form being "purer for you"..]]. (إن) a particle of jussive condition. (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable, in the position of a jussive, the protasis, and (تم) is in the position of a nominative, the ism of كنتم. (فاعلين) khabar of كنتم, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «هؤلاء بناتي ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «كنتم فاعلين ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.. and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then marry them" [[or "if you are going to do what I command you of turning back from error, then do it".]].

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab
(اللام) the lām of ibtidāʾ (commencement). (عمرك) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the khabar is obligatorily omitted, its implied form being "my oath". (إنّهم) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative.. and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (اللام) the shifted lām (or the lām of oath). (في سكرتهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (يعمهون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «لعمرك (قسمي) ...» has no grammatical position; parenthetical.
The clause «إنّهم لفي سكرتهم ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the oath.
The clause «يعمهون ...» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in سكرتهم [[and the governing word in it is the word سكرة, because it is a maṣdar.]].

* Morphology:
(لعمر): with fatḥa on the ʿayn and sukūn on the mīm, a dialectal form of عُمُر with two ḍammas; the two have one meaning, which is the span of a person's life in this world; but the Arabs kept to the fatḥa on the ʿayn in oaths because it is lighter in pronunciation.
(سكرة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral سكر; its wazn is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:73-74.t:
* I'rab
(الفاء) conjunction. (أخذت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الصيحة) fāʿil, nominative. (مشرقين) ḥāl, accusative, from the pronoun of the object in (أخذتهم), its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «أخذتهم الصيحة ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied element [[that is: "they refused to comply, so the Cry seized them".. and the clause أبوا is conjoined to the clause قال هؤلاء - verse (71).]].
(الفاء) conjunction. (جعلنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (عاليها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (ها) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (سافلها) a second mafʿūl bihi.. and (ها) is like the first. (الواو) conjunction. (أمطرنا) like جعلنا. (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أمطرنا). (حجارة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من سجّيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of حجارة.
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أخذتهم الصيحة.

* Morphology:
(مشرقين): an active participle whose singular is مشرق from the quadriliteral أشرق, that is "entered upon sunrise"; its wazn is مفعل.

safi-cedvel:75-77.t:
* I'rab
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative. (في) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to a fronted khabar.. and (اللام) indicates distance and (الكاف) indicates address. (اللام) the second, for emphasis. (آيات) the postponed ism of إنّ, accusative, its accusative marking being the kasra. (للمتوسّمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of آيات, its genitive marking being the yāʾ [[or attached to آيات, which is in the sense of "signs".]].
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction. (إنّها) like (إنّهم) [[in verse (72) of this sura.]]. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (بسبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ. (مقيم) naʿt of سبيل, genitive.
The clause has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause إنّ في ذلك.
(إن في ذلك لآية للمؤمنين) like its counterpart: إنّ ... للمتوسّمين.
And the clause has no grammatical position; a resumption confirming the first.

* Morphology:
(المتوسّمون): plural of المتوسّم, an active participle of the quinqueliteral (توسّم); its wazn is متفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- إِنَّها لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ.
The shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa): this is the lām of emphasis, also called the lām of ibtidāʾ. Its place is originally at the beginning of the speech, but when إنّ takes the beginning of the speech, the lām is driven away and moves to the khabar, whether the khabar is a single word, a sentence, or a quasi-sentence, as in this verse «وَإِنَّها لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ».
We have treated this subject in more than one place, so go back to it in its places.

safi-cedvel:78-79.t:
* I'rab
(إن) lightened from the heavy (inna), and its ism is an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). (كان) a defective past verb, a naskh verb. (أصحاب) the ism of كان, nominative. (الأيكة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (اللام) it is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa). (ظالمين) khabar of كان, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «(إن) هـ كان ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كان أصحاب ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the lightened (إن).
(الفاء) conjunction. (انتقمنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (انتقمنا). (الواو) resumptive. (إنّهما) a particle resembling the verb, and (هما) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ [[and the pronoun refers to Lūṭ and Shuʿayb, as is understood from the context, or refers to the people of Lūṭ and the people of Shuʿayb.]]. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (بإمام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ. (مبين) naʿt of إمام, genitive like it.
The clause «انتقمنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the preceding resumptive clause.
The clause «إنّهما لبإمام ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الأيكة): a noun for dense, intertwined trees; its wazn is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn; it may also be a proper name of a specific place.

* Rhetoric:
1- Majāz mursal: in His saying, the Exalted, وَإِنْ كانَ أَصْحابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظالِمِينَ, a majāz mursal whose relation is "location" (ḥāliyya), because the aykah is intertwined, crowded trees.
2- Explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya): because the road is a way of arriving, and the traveller on it follows it to the end, so the thing likened-to was used in place of the thing likened.

* Benefits:
- His saying, the Exalted, وَإِنَّهُما لَبِإِمامٍ مُبِينٍ: the grammarians differed greatly over the dual pronoun in «إنهما»..! on several views:
a- The towns of the people of Lūṭ and of the Aykah.
b- It is said that they refer to the Aykah and Madyan, because Shuʿayb was sent to both of them.
c- It is said that it refers to Lūṭ and Shuʿayb.
d- It is said that it refers to the two reports: the report of the destruction of the people of Lūṭ and the report of the destruction of the people of Shuʿayb.

safi-cedvel:80-84.t:
* I'rab
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (كذّب) a past verb. (أصحاب) fāʿil, nominative. (الحجر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (المرسلين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «كذّب أصحاب ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied oath.
(الواو) conjunction. (آتينا) a past verb together with its fāʿil, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (آياتنا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the kasra.. and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) conjunction. (كانوا) a defective past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the ism of كان. (عن) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (معرضين), which is the khabar of كانوا, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كذّب أصحاب.
The clause «كانوا عنها معرضين» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause آتيناهم.
(الواو) conjunction. (كانوا) like the first. (ينحتون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (من الجبال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ينحتون, infused with the meaning "they take". (بيوتا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (آمنين) a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ينحتون, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كانوا.. معرضين [[or parenthetical between the clause آتيناهم.. and the clause أخذتهم الصيحة.. and it is permissible for it to be in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in معرضين, with an implied قد.]].
The clause «ينحتون ...» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
(الفاء) conjunction. (أخذتهم الصيحة مصبحين) like أخذتهم.. مشرقين [[in verse (73) of this sura.]].
The clause «أخذتهم الصيحة ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumption [[that is: "so they transgressed, and the Cry seized them ..."]].
(الفاء) conjunction. (ما) a particle of negation. (أغنى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa on the alif. (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أغنى). (ما) a relative noun [[or a maṣdar particle, the interpreted maṣdar being the fāʿil.. or it is an indefinite qualified noun, the returning pronoun omitted, and the clause being its naʿt.]], indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil, the returning pronoun being omitted. (كانوا يكسبون) like كانوا ينحتون [[in verse (82) of this sura.]].
The clause «أغنى.. ما كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أخذتهم.
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يكسبون ...» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا, that is: "what they used to earn".

* Morphology:
(الحجر): a proper name, a valley between Medina and Syria; its wazn is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:85-86.t:
* I'rab
(الواو) resumptive. (ما خلقنا) like ما أغنى.. and (نا) is the fāʿil. (السموات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the kasra. (الأرض) conjoined to السموات by the wāw, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, conjoined to السموات. (بينهما) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما..
and (هما) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (إلّا) a particle of restriction. (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, that is: "except a creating accompanied by the truth". (الواو) conjunction. (إنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative. (الساعة) the ism of إنّ, accusative. (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. (آتية) khabar, nominative. (الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (اصفح) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (الصفح) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative. (الجميل) naʿt of الصفح, accusative.
The clause «ما خلقنا.. إلّا» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الساعة لآتية» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «اصفح ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you are harmed, then forgive".
(إنّ ربّك) like إنّ الساعة.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ [[or a separating pronoun, with (الخلّاق) the khabar of إنّ.]]. (الخلّاق) khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو, nominative. (العليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّ ربّك ...» has no grammatical position; causal for the preceding command.
The clause «هو الخلّاق ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(الصفح): a samāʿī maṣdar of the triliteral verb صفح (of the bāb of fatḥa); its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الجميل): a ṣifa mushabbaha from the triliteral verb جمل (of the bāb of karuma), on the wazn فعيل.
(الخلّاق): an intensive form of the active participle, from the triliteral خلق; its wazn is فعّال.

safi-cedvel:87-87.t:
* I'rab
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of an oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (آتيناك) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn.. and (نا) is the fāʿil and (الكاف) is mafʿūl bihi. (سبعا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من المثاني) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (سبعا), its genitive marking being the implied kasra on the yāʾ. (الواو) conjunction. (القرآن) conjoined to (سبعا), accusative. (العظيم) naʿt of القرآن, accusative.
The clause «آتيناك ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied oath..
and the oath clause is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(المثاني): plural of المثنى, which is everything that is repeated. There is disagreement over the interpretation of المثاني in the noble verse. It is said that it is al-Fātiḥa, because its verses are seven, or because it is repeated in every prayer and every rakʿa, and there are other opinions about it.. And it is said that المثاني are the seven long sūras, the first of which is Sūrat al-Baqara and the last Sūrat al-Anfāl and Barāʾa.. And it is said they are the sūras that begin with (حم).. And it is said that what is meant is the whole Qur'an ... etc. The wazn of المثاني is مفاعل.

* Benefits:
1- The commentators differed over السبع المثاني in opinions, the most plausible of which are two:
a- It is said that it is al-Fātiḥa, because it is recited in every rakʿa, and it is seven verses.
b- And it is said that they are the seven long sūras, because many matters are repeated in them.

safi-cedvel:88-89.t:
* I'rab
(لا) prohibitive. (تمدّن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive..
and (النون) is for emphasis; the fāʿil is "you". (عينيك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (تمدّن). (متّعنا) a past verb together with its fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (متّعنا). (أزواجا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an adjective of (أزواجا). (الواو) conjunction. (لا) like the first. (تحزن) an imperfect verb, jussive; the fāʿil is "you". (عليهم) like منهم, attached to (تحزن). (الواو) conjunction. (اخفض) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (جناحك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun in genitive construct. (للمؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اخفض).
The clause «لا تمدّنّ ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «متّعنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تحزن ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا تمدّنّ.
The clause «اخفض ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا تمدّنّ.
(الواو) conjunction. (قل) like اخفض. (إنّي) a particle resembling the verb.. and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of إنّ. (أنا) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ [[it is permissible for the pronoun to be borrowed for the position of the accusative, as tawkīd of the ism of إنّ.]]. (النذير) khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنا, nominative. (المبين) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا تمدّنّ.
The clause «إنّي أنا النذير ...» is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying.
The clause «أنا النذير ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
- Kināya: in His saying, the Exalted, وَاخْفِضْ جَناحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ, a kināya for humility toward them and gentleness with them. The origin of that is that a bird, when it wants to draw its chick to itself, spreads its wings over it; and the two wings of the son of Adam are his two sides.

safi-cedvel:90-91.t:
* I'rab
(الكاف) a preposition of comparison [[or a noun meaning "like", a mafʿūl muṭlaq.]]. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq [[the commentators and the i'rab scholars differed over the implied form of this omitted element, and all of them go back to a near or a distant interpretation; the nearest of them is: "We gave you a giving like that which We sent down upon the dividers". Abū Ḥayyān chose that it be an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being "Say a saying like that which We sent down upon the dividers".]]. (أنزلنا) like متّعنا [[in verse (88) of this sura.]]. (على المقتسمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزلنا).
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
(الذين) a relative noun in the position of a genitive, naʿt of المقتسمين [[or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they"; and the clause is an explanatory resumption.]]. (جعلوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (القرآن) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (عضين) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural.
The clause «جعلوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).

* Morphology:
(المقتسمين): plural of المقتسم, that is, the one who divided the Book, believing in part and disbelieving in part; it is an active participle of the quinqueliteral verb اقتسم; its wazn is مفتعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(عضين): plural of عضة, whose original is عضوة, from عضا الشاة when one makes it into pieces (aʿḍāʾ); and it is said it is عضهة from عضهته when you slander him. In al-Mukhtār: al-Kisāʾī said: العضة is lying and slander, and its plural is عضون, like عزة and عزون.. It is said that the wāw is what was dropped from it, and that it is from عضوته, that is "I divided it", because the polytheists divided their sayings and made it falsehood, soothsaying and poetry; and it is said that the hāʾ is what was dropped, and its original is عضهة, because العضة and العضين in the language of Quraysh mean sorcery. [[Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal on al-Jalālayn.]]

* Benefits:
- The word «عضين» is parsed as the sound masculine plural is parsed: it is nominative with the wāw, and accusative and genitive with the yāʾ, because it is among its appendages. We had touched upon the appendages of the sound masculine plural, and to complete the benefit we detail here what we summarised there: the appendages of the masculine plural are those that are parsed like it without fulfilling its conditions. They are four groups:
a- The first, collective nouns, and they are «أولو, وعالمون, and the tens from twenty to ninety».
b- The second: broken plurals, and they are «بنون, أرضون, سنون, عضون, عزون, ثبون».
c- The third: sound plurals that have not fulfilled the conditions of the plural, such as «أهلون and وابلون».
d- The fourth: what is used as a name from this plural and from what is appended to it, such as زيدون and عليون.
Thus we have presented to you the eloquent of the appendages of this plural, and kept silent about the irregular ones for fear of prolixity.
If you are one of long breath, then seek the completion of this discussion in the lengthy books of grammar.

safi-cedvel:92-93.t:
* I'rab
(الفاء) resumptive. (الواو) the wāw of oath. (ربّك) genitive by the wāw, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear".. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) the lām of an oath. (نسألنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative.. and (النون) is for emphasis; the fāʿil is "We", and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (أجمعين) tawkīd of the third-person pronoun, accusative [[or a ḥāl, accusative, from the pronoun of the object.]], its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «(أقسم) بربّك ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «نسألنّهم ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to the oath.
(عن) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar particle [[or a relative in the position of a genitive, the returning pronoun omitted, and the clause after it a ṣila..]]. (كانوا) a defective past verb..
and (الواو) is the ism of كان. (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of a genitive, attached to (نسألنّهم).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar (ما).
The clause «يعملون ...» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:94-96.t:
* I'rab
(الفاء) resumptive. (اصدع) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (اصدع). (الواو) conjunction. (أعرض) like اصدع, and (تؤمر) an imperfect verb, nominative, passive, its nāʾib fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you". (عن المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعرض).
The clause «اصدع ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تؤمر ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما) [[and the returning pronoun is omitted, its implied form being "you are commanded it".. by dropping the preposition and making the verb transitive to the pronoun.. and it is not valid for (ما) to be a maṣdar particle, since it is not possible to interpret a explicit maṣdar from a passive verb with a maṣdar particle.]].
The clause «أعرض ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause اصدع.
(إنّا) like إنّي [[in verse (89) of this sura.]]. (كفيناك) like آتيناك [[in verse (87) of this sura.]]. (المستهزئين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّا كفيناك ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «كفيناك ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّا.
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, naʿt of المستهزئين [[or in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause سوف يعلمون with the fāʾ redundant because of the mubtadaʾ's resemblance to a condition.. or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being ...]]. (يجعلون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إلها) the first mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (آخر) naʿt of (إلها), accusative, and it is withheld from tanwīn because it is an adjective on the wazn أفعل. (الفاء) resumptive. (سوف) a particle of futurity. (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and its object is omitted, that is: "they will know the outcome of their affair".
The clause «يجعلون ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يعلمون ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
- Implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya): in His saying, the Exalted, فَاصْدَعْ بِما تُؤْمَرُ. The thing borrowed from is the glass vessel, the thing borrowed is the cracking (ṣadʿ), which is splitting, and the thing borrowed for is the disobedience of those held to account; it is a borrowing of the perceptible for the intelligible. The meaning is: proclaim openly everything that has been revealed to you and make clear everything you were commanded to make clear, even if that is hard on some hearts so that they crack.

safi-cedvel:97-99.t:
* I'rab
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation [[because the knowledge of Allah is certain at every moment.]]. (نعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is "We", for magnification. (أنّ) a particle of emphasis that governs the accusative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the ism of أنّ. (يضيق) like نعلم. (صدرك) fāʿil, nominative, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar particle. (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّك يضيق ...) is in the position of an accusative, standing in for the two objects of نعلم.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يقولون) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يضيق).
The clause «نعلم ...» has no grammatical position; it is the answer to an implied oath.. and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يضيق صدرك ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the maṣdar particle (ما).
(الفاء) the linking particle of the apodosis of an implied condition. (سبّح) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you". (بحمد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of سبّح, that is: "comprising (or accompanied by) the praise of your Lord". (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive ... and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) conjunction. (كن) a defective imperative verb, its ism a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you". (من الساجدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of كن.
The clause «سبّح ...» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if your chest is tightened, then glorify".
The clause «كن من الساجدين» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause سبّح.
(الواو) conjunction. (اعبد) like سبّح. (ربّك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative ...
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi. (حتّى) a particle of limit and of genitive. (يأتيك) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتّى ... and (الكاف) is mafʿūl bihi. (اليقين) fāʿil, nominative.
The clause «اعبد ...» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause كن من الساجدين.
The clause «يأتيك اليقين» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied maṣdar particle (أن)
[Translator's note: the entry ends here in the source, without a final full stop.]

semin-durr:1-1.t: His saying, the Exalted: {تِلْكَ آيَاتُ}: its parallel was mentioned at the beginning of al-Raʿd. The pointing with «تلك» is to what the sūra contains, and al-Zamakhsharī mentioned nothing else. It was also said: it is a pointer to the earlier Books. The indefiniteness of «قرآن» is for magnification.

semin-durr:2-2.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {رُّبَمَا}: «رُبَّ» has two views. One: that it is a preposition (ḥarf jarr); the Kufans, Abū l-Ḥasan [al-Akhfash] and Ibn al-Ṭarāwa claimed that it is a noun. Its meaning is fewness (taqlīl) according to the well-known view. It was also said that it denotes abundance. It was also said that it denotes abundance in places of boasting, as in his saying:
2922 - 0- فيا رُبَّ يومٍ قد لَهَوْتُ وليلةٍ ... بآنسةٍ كأنها خطُّ تِمْثالِ (How many a day and night have I whiled away with a charming girl, as though she were the outline of a statue)
and it has been answered that this is to make a parallel few. The proofs of these views belong to grammar. It has many dialects, the best known of which is «رُبَ» with ḍamma, doubled or lightened; Nāfiʿ and ʿĀṣim read with the second. And «رَبَ» with fatḥa, doubled and lightened, and «رُبْ» and «رَبْ» with ḍamma and fatḥa and sukūn in both. The tāʾ of feminine gender is attached to all of these, and with the tāʾ Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif and Zayd ibn ʿAlī read: «رُبَّتَما». When the tāʾ is attached to it, sukūn and fatḥa are both allowed on it, as in «thummata» and «lāta», so the forms multiply. It has many rules, among them: the requirement that it stand at the head [of the clause]; among them that its genitive object be indefinite, and his saying:
292 - 3- رُبَّما الجامِلِ المُؤَبَّلِ فيهمُ ... وعَنَاجيجُ بينهنَّ المهَارى (How many a herd of camels is among them, and swift mounts, among which are riding camels)
is a poetic necessity in the transmission of the one who put «الجامِل» in the genitive. It also governs in the genitive a pronoun that requires explanation by an indefinite noun after it, in which dual, plural and feminine forms of the noun suffice in place of dual, plural and feminine forms of the pronoun, as in his saying:
292 - 4- . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... ورُبَّه عَطِباً أَنْقَذْتُ مِنْ عَطَبِهْ (... and how many a man in peril have I rescued from his peril)
Agreement, as in «رُبَّهما رجلين», is rare. At times what is annexed to the pronoun of its genitive object is conjoined to it, as in «رُبَّ رجلٍ وأخيه». Is it necessary that its genitive object be described, and that what is attached to it be in the past? There is disagreement; the sound view is that this is not necessary. Among instances of it without a description is the saying of Hind:
292 - 5- يا رُبَّ قائلةٍ غداً ... يا لهفَ أمِّ مُعاويهْ (O how many a woman will say tomorrow: Alas for the mother of Muʿāwiya!)
and among instances of the future is his saying:
292 - 6- فإنْ أَهْلَِكْ فربَّ فتىً سيبكيْ ... عليَّ مهذَّبٍ رَخْصِ البَنانِ (If I perish, how many a refined youth, soft of fingertip, will weep over me)
and her saying «يا رُبَّ قائلةٍ غداً», the verse, and the saying of Sulaym:
292 - 7- ومعتصمٍ بالحيِّ من خشية الرَّدى ... سيُرْدى وغازٍ مُشْفِقٍ سَيَؤُوب (How many a one who seeks refuge with the tribe for fear of death will perish, and a fearful raider will return)
for the particle of extension [of time] and «غداً» restricted the two to the future.
And «ما» in «رُبما» admits two aspects. The more apparent: that it is the enabling one (al-muhayyiʾa), meaning that «رُبَّ» is specific to nouns, so when «ما» came it enabled its entry on verbs. A parallel was mentioned earlier with «inna» and its sisters. It also restrains it from governing, as in his saying:
292 - 8- رُبَّما الجامِلُ المُؤَبَّلُ. . . . . . . . . ... . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
in the transmission of the one who put it in the nominative, as happened with the kāf of comparison. The second: that «ما» is an indefinite noun described by the clause following it, and the returning pronoun to «ما» is omitted, its implied form being: «رُبَّ شيءٍ يَوَدُّه الذين كفروا» (how often a thing that those who disbelieved wish for).
And His saying: {يَوَدُّ الذين كَفَرُواْ}: whoever does not require that what is attached to it be past needs no interpretation; whoever does require that says: because what is awaited in the reports of Allah the Exalted is certain to happen, He expressed it in the past to confirm its occurrence, like His saying {أتى أَمْرُ الله} [al-Naḥl: 1] and the like.
His saying: {لَوْ كَانُواْ}: «لو» may be the one of prevention (imtināʿiyya), and in that case its answer is omitted, its implied form being: "if they had been Muslims they would have been glad of that," or "they would have been delivered from what they are in." The object of «يَوَدُّ» is omitted on this implication, that is: "Those who disbelieved will often wish for deliverance"; the preventive clause indicates it.
The second: that it is maṣdar-forming, according to those who hold that, as was explained in al-Baqara. In that case this maṣdar is the object of the wishing, that is: "they wish for their being Muslims," if we make «ما» a restraining one; and if we make it indefinite, «لو» and what falls within its scope is a badal (substitute) of «ما».

semin-durr:3-3.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {ذَرْهُمْ}: no past is used for this except rarely, «تَرَكَ» sufficing in its place; rather, the imperfect is used from it, as in {وَيَذَرُهُمْ} [al-Aʿrāf: 186]. An instance of the past is his saying, peace be upon him: «ذَرُوا الحبشة ما وَذَرَتْكم» ("Leave the Abyssinians alone as long as they leave you alone"). Similar is «دَعْ» and «يَدَعُ»; «وَدَعَ» is said only rarely, and «ما وَدَعك» has been read with lightening, and they recited his saying:
292 - 9- سَلْ أميري ما الذي غيَّرهْ ... عن وصالي اليومَ حتى وَدَعَهْ (Ask my master what has changed him toward me today, such that he has left [me])
And {يَأْكُلُواْ} is jussive as the answer to the imperative. It was mentioned earlier that «تَرَكَ» and «ذَرْ» may be in the sense of «ṣayyara» (to make), and on this the second object is omitted, that is: «ذَرْهُمْ مُهْمِلين» (leave them neglected); and «يأكلوا» is not the second object, nor a ḥāl, since it would have to be nominative.

semin-durr:4-4.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {إِلاَّ وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ}: there are several aspects in it. The first, which is the apparent one, is that it is the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and then you have two considerations. One: that you make the ḥāl the preposition and its genitive noun alone, and «كتابٌ» is nominative by it as an agent. The second: that you make the preposition phrase a fronted predicate, with «كتاب» a mubtadaʾ and the clause a ḥāl; and this ḥāl is inseparable.
The second: that the wāw is redundant, and he supported this by the reading of Ibn Abī ʿAbla «إلا لها» without it. But redundancy is not easy.
The third: that the wāw enters the clause that serves as an adjective, for emphasis. Al-Zamakhsharī said: "The clause serves as an adjective of «قرية», and by analogy this wāw should not intervene between them, as in His saying {وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلاَّ لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ} [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 208]. It intervenes only to emphasize the attachment of the adjective to the thing described, as you say: «جاءني زيد عليه ثوبُه» and «جاءني وعليه ثوبُه»." Abū l-Baqāʾ, the Exalted, followed al-Zamakhsharī in that, and he had said so before in al-Baqara at His saying, the Exalted: {وعسى أَن تَكْرَهُواْ شَيْئاً وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ} [verse 216].
The Shaykh [Abū Ḥayyān] said: "We do not know any grammarian who said this, and I recall that Ibn Jinnī preceded the two of them to that." Then the Shaykh said: "It is built on the permissibility of what follows «إلا» being an adjective, and they have forbidden that. Al-Akhfash said: «No separation is made between the adjective and the thing described by «إلا»». Then he said: as for «ما جاءني رجلٌ إلا راكبٌ», on the implication «إلا رجلٌ راكب», there is ugliness in it, because you make the adjective like the noun." Abū ʿAlī said: "You say «ما مررتُ بأحدٍ إلا قائماً», with «قائماً» a ḥāl, and you do not say «إلا قائمٍ», because «illā» does not intervene between the adjective and the thing described." Ibn Mālik said, having mentioned what al-Zamakhsharī held in «ما مررت بأحدٍ إلا زيدٌ خيرٌ منه», that the clause after «إلا» is an adjective of «أحد»: "It is a position not known from any Basran or Kufan, so no heed is paid to it," and he declared false his statement that the wāw intervenes to emphasize the attachment of the adjective to the thing described.
I say: al-Zamakhsharī's statement is strong in terms of analogy, for the adjective is like the ḥāl in meaning, even if there is a difference between them in some respects. Just as the wāw enters the clause that serves as a ḥāl, so it enters it when it serves as an adjective. What he offered as its parallel in the other verse, His saying {إِلاَّ لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ}, also strengthens it, as does the reading of Ibn Abī ʿAbla mentioned earlier.
Mundhir ibn Saʿīd said: "This wāw is the one that indicates that the state after it, in wording, is in time before the state preceding the wāw, and from it is His saying, the Exalted: {حتى إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا} [al-Zumar: 73]."

semin-durr:5-5.t: His saying, the Exalted: {مِنْ أُمَّةٍ}: the agent of «تَسْبِقُ», and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis. It was construed on the wording of «أمَّة» in His saying «أجلَها», so it is singular and feminine; and on its meaning in His saying {وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ}, so it is plural and masculine. What is attached to «يَسْتأخِرُون» is omitted, its implied form being «عنه», since the context indicates it and since it falls as a verse ending.

semin-durr:6-6.t: His saying, the Exalted: {نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذكر}: the majority read «نُزِّل» doubled and passive; Zayd ibn ʿAlī read «نَزَلَ» lightened and active.

semin-durr:7-7.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {لَّوْ مَا}: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) like «hallā», and it also functions as a particle of prevention due to existence, just as «lawlā» alternates between these two meanings. The difference between them is known: the urging one is followed only by a verb, overt or latent, as in his saying:
293 - 0-. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ... . . . . . لولا الكَمِيَّ المُقَنَّعَا (... why do you not [strike] the armoured, helmeted warrior)
while the preventive one is followed only by nouns, in wording or in implication, according to the Basrans. And his saying:
293 - 1- ولولا يَحْسَبُون الحِلْمَ عَجْزاً ... لَمَا عَدِمَ المُسِيْئُون احتمالي (Were they not to count forbearance as weakness, the wrongdoers would not have lacked my tolerance)
is interpreted, against the Kufans. Among instances of «لَوْما» as a particle of prevention is his saying:
293 - 2- لَوْما الحياءُ ولوما الدينُ عِبْتُكما ... ببعضِ ما فيكما إذ عِبْتُما عَوَري (Were it not for modesty and were it not for religion, I would have reproached you both for some of what is in you, since you reproached me for my blemish)
They differed over it: is it simple or compound? Al-Zamakhsharī said: «لو» is compounded with «لا» and with «ما» for two meanings, whereas «هل» is compounded only with «لا» alone, for urging. They also differed over «لوما»: is it a base form in itself, or a derivative of «لولا», with the mīm substituted for the lām, as in their saying «خالَلْتُه» and «خالَمْته», so he is «خِلِّي» and «خِلْمي», that is: my friend? They also said «استولى عليَّ كذا» and «استومَى عليه» in a [single] sense? — a well-known disagreement. This clause of urging indicates the answer of the condition that follows it.

semin-durr:8-8.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {مَا نُنَزِّلُ الملائكة}: Abū Bakr read «ما نُنَزِّل» with ḍamma on the tāʾ, and fatḥa on the nūn and on the zāy, doubled, as a passive, with «الملائكةُ» nominative because it stands in the place of its agent. This agrees with His saying: {وَنُزِّلَ الملائكة تَنزِيلاً} [al-Furqān: 25], and with the fact that they are sent down only by the command of Allah, so someone other than they is the one who sends them down, and that is Allah the Exalted.
[Translator's note: the source writes the opening of Abū Bakr's reading as «ما نُنَزِّل» although it then describes ḍamma on the tāʾ; the intended form is evidently «ما تُنَزَّلُ». I have translated the description as written.]
The two brothers [Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī] and Ḥafṣ read with ḍamma on the nūn, fatḥa on the second [nūn], and kasra on the zāy, doubled, as an active verb of the Magnifier [the plural of majesty], who is the Creator, the Exalted, with «الملائكةَ» accusative as its object. It agrees with His saying, the Exalted: {وَلَوْ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ الملائكة} [al-Anʿām: 111], and suits His saying before that, {وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا} [al-Ḥijr: 4], and His saying after it, {إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا} [al-Ḥijr: 9], and the expressions of magnification that follow. The rest of the Seven read «ما تَنَزَّلُ» with fatḥa on the tāʾ, the nūn and the zāy, doubled, with «الملائكةُ» nominative as the agent. The original is «تَتَنَزَّل» with two tāʾs, one of which is omitted, and its explanation was given earlier at {تَذَكَّرُونَ} [al-Anʿām: 152] and the like. It agrees with His saying {تَنَزَّلُ الملائكة والروح فِيهَا} [al-Qadr: 4].
Zayd ibn ʿAlī read «ما نَزَلَ» lightened, as an active, with «الملائكة» nominative as the agent, like His saying {نَزَلَ بِهِ الروح الأمين} [al-Shuʿarāʾ: 193].
His saying: {إِلاَّ بالحق}: it may be attached to the verb before it, or to an omitted element as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent or the object, that is: "bound up with the truth." Al-Zamakhsharī made it an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, that is: "a sending down bound up with the truth."
His saying: «إَذَنْ»: al-Zamakhsharī said: «إذن» is a particle of answer and consequence, because it is an answer to them, and the consequence of the condition is implied, its implied form being: "And had We sent down the angels, they would not have been granted respite, and their punishment would not have been delayed."

semin-durr:9-9.t: His saying, the Exalted: {نَحْنُ}: either a mubtadaʾ (subject) or an emphasis (tawkīd); it cannot be a separator (faṣl) because it does not fall between two nouns. The pronoun in «له» refers to the Reminder (al-dhikr), and this is the apparent view. It was also said: to the Messenger, peace be upon him.

semin-durr:10-10.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {أَرْسَلْنَا}: its object is omitted, that is: "We sent messengers before you." So «مِنْ قبلك» may be attached to «أَرْسَلْنَا», or to an omitted element as an adjective of the omitted object.
And {شِيَعِ الأولين}: al-Farrāʾ said: "It is an annexation of the thing described to its description; the original is «في الشِّيَع الأولين», like «صلاة الأُولى» and «جانب الغربيّ»." The Basrans interpret it by omission of the thing described, that is: «في شِيَع الأممِ الأوَّلين», «جانب المكانِ الغربي», «صلاة الساعةِ الأولى».

semin-durr:11-11.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم}: al-Zamakhsharī said: "It is a narration of a past situation, because «ما» does not enter on an imperfect unless it is in the position of the ḥāl, nor on a past unless it is close to the ḥāl." What he mentioned is the more frequent in their speech, but it has come in conjunction with an imperfect intended for the future, as in His saying, the Exalted: {قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لي أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُ مِن تِلْقَآءِ نفسي} [Yūnus: 15], and they recited the verse of al-Aʿshā in praise of the Prophet ﷺ:
293 - 3- له صَدَقاتٌ ما يَغِبُّ نَوالُها ... وليس عطاءُ اليومِ مانِعَه غَدا (He has gifts whose bounty never lapses, and today's giving does not prevent his giving tomorrow)
and the saying of Abū Dhuʾayb:
293 - 4- أودَى بَنِيَّ وأَوْدَعُونيْ حَسْرة ... عند الرُّقَادِ وعَبْرةً ما تُقْلِعً (My sons perished and left me a sorrow at sleeping-time and a tear that never ceases)
His saying: {إِلاَّ كَانُواْ}: this clause may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «يَأتِيهمْ». It may also be an adjective of «رسول», in which case there are two aspects regarding its position: genitive in respect of the wording, and nominative in respect of the position; and if it is a ḥāl, it is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara).

semin-durr:12-12.t:
His saying, the Exalted: {كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ}: the kāf may be nominative in position as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), that is: «الأمرُ كذلك» (the matter is thus), with «نَسْلُكُه» resumptive. It may also be accusative in position: either an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, that is: «مثلَ ذلك السَّلْكِ ونحوِه نَسْلُكُه» (in the like of that insertion We insert it), that is, We insert the Reminder; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied maṣdar.
The hāʾ in «نَسْلُكُه» may refer back to the Reminder (al-dhikr), and this is the apparent view. It was also said: it refers to the mockery. It was also said: to polytheism.

semin-durr:13-13.t:
The hāʾ in {بِهِ} may refer back to the three that preceded; and the interpretation of its referring to mockery and polytheism is: "they do not believe because of it." It was also said: to the Messenger; and it was said: to the Qurʾān. Abū l-Baqāʾ said: "It may be a ḥāl, that is: they do not believe, mocking." I say: it is as though he made «به» attached to the omitted ḥāl, standing in its place; but this is rejected, because a preposition phrase, when it occurs as a ḥāl, an adjective, a relative clause or a predicate, is attached to an unrestricted existence, not a specific one, and likewise the adverbial.
The position of {لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ} is accusative as a ḥāl, and it is possible that it has no position, because it is an explanation of His saying {كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ}.
And His saying {وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الأولين} is resumptive.
Al-salk: insertion. It is said: «سَلَكْتُ الخيطَ في الإبْرة» (I threaded the thread through the needle), and from it comes {مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ} [al-Muddaththir: 42]. It is said «سَلَكَه» and «أَسْلكه», that is: he strung it. The poet said:
293 - 5- وكنتُ لِزازَ خَصْمِك لم أُعَرِّدْ ... وقد سَلَكُوكَ في أَمْرٍ عَصِيْبِ (I was the close companion of your adversary, I did not flee, when they had drawn you into a hard affair)
and another said, with «أَسَلَكَ»:
293 - 6- حتى إذا أَسْلَكُوهمْ في قُتائِدَةٍ ... شَلاًّ كما تَطْرُدُ الجَمَّالةُ الشُّرُدا (until, when they drove them into a narrow pass, driving them as camel-herders drive the stray camels)

semin-durr:14-14.t: His saying, the Exalted: {فَظَلُّواْ}: it is the incomplete verb (nāqiṣa), and the pronoun in «فظلُّوا» refers to the disbelievers for whom the door was opened. It was also said: it refers to the angels. Al-Aʿmash and Abū Ḥaywa read «يَعْرِجون» with kasra on the rāʾ, which is in the dialect of Hudhayl for «عَرَجَ يَعْرِجُ», that is: he ascended.

semin-durr:15-15.t:
